query:
UPDATE collegia SET
               name = COALESCE($2, name),
               description = CASE
                   WHEN $3::TEXT IS NULL THEN description
                   WHEN $3 = '' THEN NULL
                   ELSE $3
               END,
               is_private = COALESCE($4, is_private),
               review_visibility = COALESCE(
                   $5::collegium_review_visibility, review_visibility)
           WHERE id = $1
